response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Repeated throughout the paragraphs discussing “the flesh” (especially the paragraph beginning “Jesus said” and the following paragraph beginning “The flesh is flesh”)","severity":"major","source_quote":"“The flesh only thinks of itself” and “The flesh is flesh, and the spirit is spirit, and they are opposed to each other.”","suggested_fix":"Where “flesh” means the sinful human nature opposed to the Spirit, use a term such as “पापमय स्वभाव” or “शारीरिक स्वभाव” rather than “शरीर”; for example, “पापमय स्वभाव केवल अपने बारे में सोचता है” and “पापमय स्वभाव और आत्मा एक-दूसरे के विरोधी हैं।” Apply this distinction consistently in the surrounding discussion.","translation_quote":"“शरीर केवल अपने बारे में सोचता है” and “शरीर शरीर है, और आत्मा आत्मा है, और वे एक-दूसरे के विरोधी हैं।”"}],"findings_complete":true,"passed":false,"score":92}
